trickyParts: The spawn write is placed after processManager.spawnWorker resolves so a 403/409/400 spawn writes nothing, and before the response so every accepted spawn (spawned/resumed/queued) writes; ctx.save() follows only when a status was written.

knownIssueStatus is used by both the spawn and the completion decision, so a spawn whose in_progress PATCH failed (recorded pending) is still followed by testing on completion, and a second spawn on the same issue does not write in_progress twice.
